# GarageReplication v1beta1

<!-- Generated by hack/generate_api_reference.py from controller-gen CRDs. Do not edit. -->

API version: `garage.rajsingh.info/v1beta1`. Scope: Namespaced.

The [custom-resource guide](../custom-resources.md) explains operational behavior. The [JSON schemas](../samples.md) are the validation source of truth.

## Spec

GarageReplicationSpec defines the desired state of GarageReplication. GarageReplication copies objects between two independent Garage clusters through their S3 APIs, for replication and migration. It is not a backup: there are no point-in-time snapshots and no restore, and in mode Mirror a deletion or an overwrite on the source reaches the destination on the next run. Each run executes one Kubernetes Job per bucket in the GarageReplication's namespace, so the Jobs need network access to both S3 endpoints. Only objects (and their user metadata) are copied: buckets, keys, permissions, quotas, website and lifecycle configuration are not. Deleting a GarageReplication never deletes object data on either side.

| `podTemplate.tolerations[].effect` | string |  | Effect indicates the taint effect to match. Empty means match all taint effects. When specified, allowed values are NoSchedule, PreferNoSchedule and NoExecute. |
| `podTemplate.tolerations[].key` | string |  | Key is the taint key that the toleration applies to. Empty means match all taint keys. If the key is empty, operator must be Exists; this combination means to match all values and all keys. |

Lt and Gt perform numeric comparisons (requires feature gate TaintTolerationComparisonOperators). |

| `resources.claims[].name` | string | required | Name must match the name of one entry in pod.spec.resourceClaims of the Pod where this field is used. It makes that resource available inside a container. |
| `resources.claims[].request` | string |  | Request is the name chosen for a request in the referenced claim. If empty, everything from the claim is made available, otherwise only the result of this request. |

| `resources.requests` | map of integer or string |  | Requests describes the minimum amount of compute resources required. If Requests is omitted for a container, it defaults to Limits if that is explicitly specified, otherwise to an implementation-defined value. Requests cannot exceed Limits. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/ |
| `retry` | object |  | Retry bounds retries and duration of each per-bucket Job. |
| `retry.activeDeadlineSeconds` | integer | default: 21600; format: "int64"; min: 60 | ActiveDeadlineSeconds bounds the duration of a per-bucket Job. |
| `retry.backoffLimit` | integer | default: 2; format: "int32"; min: 0; max: 10 | BackoffLimit is the number of Pod retries of a per-bucket Job. Each retry restarts the bucket's comparison; already copied objects are skipped. |

| `source.clusterRef.kubeConfigSecretRef` | object |  | KubeConfigSecretRef is reserved for a future remote Kubernetes client integration. It is currently rejected by admission because the operator does not use it. |
| `source.clusterRef.kubeConfigSecretRef.key` | string | required | The key of the secret to select from. Must be a valid secret key. |
| `source.clusterRef.kubeConfigSecretRef.name` | string | default: "" | Name of the referent. This field is effectively required, but due to backwards compatibility is allowed to be empty. Instances of this type with an empty value here are almost certainly wrong. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names |
| `source.clusterRef.kubeConfigSecretRef.optional` | boolean |  | Specify whether the Secret or its key must be defined |
| `source.clusterRef.name` | string | required | Name of the GarageCluster resource. |
| `source.clusterRef.namespace` | string |  | Namespace of the GarageCluster. Defaults to the referencing resource's namespace. Cross-namespace references require a GarageReferenceGrant where supported by the owning resource. GarageNode and GarageAdminToken reject them. |
| `source.credentialsSecretRef` | object | required; validation: accessKeyIdKey and secretAccessKeyKey must be different | CredentialsSecretRef references a Secret in the GarageReplication's namespace holding an S3 access key. The Secret must opt in: either it is the Secret generated for a GarageKey, or it carries the label garage.rajsingh.info/replication-credentials: "true". The access key ID is sent to the endpoint, so without this opt-in the right to create a GarageReplication would amount to reading any Secret. The default data keys match the Secret generated for a GarageKey. |
| `source.credentialsSecretRef.accessKeyIdKey` | string | default: "access-key-id"; min length: 1; max length: 253; pattern: "^\[-._a-zA-Z0-9\]+$" | AccessKeyIDKey is the data key holding the access key ID. |
| `source.credentialsSecretRef.name` | string | required; min length: 1; max length: 253; pattern: "^\[a-z0-9\](\[-a-z0-9\]*\[a-z0-9\])?(\\.\[a-z0-9\](\[-a-z0-9\]*\[a-z0-9\])?)*$" | Name of the Secret in the GarageReplication's namespace. |
| `source.credentialsSecretRef.secretAccessKeyKey` | string | default: "secret-access-key"; min length: 1; max length: 253; pattern: "^\[-._a-zA-Z0-9\]+$" | SecretAccessKeyKey is the data key holding the secret access key. |
| `source.endpoint` | object |  | Endpoint is an S3 endpoint of any Garage cluster, inside or outside Kubernetes. |
| `source.endpoint.caBundleRef` | object |  | CABundleRef references a ConfigMap holding a PEM CA bundle used, in addition to the system trust store, to verify the endpoint's TLS certificate. |
| `source.endpoint.caBundleRef.key` | string | default: "ca.crt"; min length: 1; max length: 253; pattern: "^\[-._a-zA-Z0-9\]+$" | Key of the ConfigMap holding the PEM bundle. |
| `source.endpoint.caBundleRef.name` | string | required; min length: 1; max length: 253; pattern: "^\[a-z0-9\](\[-a-z0-9\]*\[a-z0-9\])?(\\.\[a-z0-9\](\[-a-z0-9\]*\[a-z0-9\])?)*$" | Name of the ConfigMap. |
| `source.endpoint.region` | string | default: "garage"; min length: 1; max length: 128; pattern: "^\[A-Za-z0-9_.-\]+$" | Region is the Garage s3_region used for request signing. |
| `source.endpoint.url` | string | required; min length: 1; max length: 2048; pattern: "^https?://\[^\\s/?#@\]+/?$" | URL of the S3 API: scheme and host (with an optional port) only, e.g. https://s3.example.com or http://garage.ns.svc:3900. Buckets are addressed path-style below it, so it has no path, query, fragment or credentials. |
| `successfulJobsHistoryLimit` | integer | default: 1; format: "int32"; min: 0; max: 50 | SuccessfulJobsHistoryLimit is the number of finished successful Jobs to keep. |
| `suspend` | boolean |  | Suspend stops starting new runs. A run already in progress finishes; delete its Jobs to stop it immediately. |
| `transfer` | object |  | Transfer tunes the copy. |
| `transfer.bandwidthLimit` | string | max length: 32; pattern: "^\[0-9\]+(\\.\[0-9\]+)?\[KMGkmg\]?$" | BandwidthLimit caps the transfer rate of each per-bucket Job in bytes per second, with an optional K, M, G suffix (e.g. "50M"). Empty means unlimited. |
| `transfer.checkers` | integer | default: 8; format: "int32"; min: 1; max: 128 | Checkers is the number of objects compared in parallel per bucket. |
| `transfer.concurrency` | integer | default: 4; format: "int32"; min: 1; max: 64 | Concurrency is the number of objects transferred in parallel per bucket. |
| `transfer.maxConcurrentBuckets` | integer | default: 1; format: "int32"; min: 1; max: 50 | MaxConcurrentBuckets is the number of buckets replicated in parallel. |
| `verification` | string | default: "None"; enum: \["None", "Check"\] | Verification runs a comparison of source and destination after each successful copy. Check compares sizes and MD5 hashes (size only for multipart objects without a stored MD5) and fails the run on any difference. |

### Cross-field validation

- mirror must be set if and only if mode is Mirror: `has(self.mirror) == (has(self.mode) && self.mode == 'Mirror')`

- a bucket cannot be replicated onto itself: source and destination are the same endpoint: `!(has(self.source.endpoint) && has(self.destination.endpoint) && self.source.endpoint.url.lowerAscii() == self.destination.endpoint.url.lowerAscii()) || self.buckets.all(b, b.source != b.destination)`

## Status

GarageReplicationStatus defines the observed state of GarageReplication.

| Field path | Type | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `buckets` | array of object |  | Buckets reports per-bucket results, keyed by destination bucket. |
| `buckets[].activeJob` | string |  | ActiveJob is the Job currently replicating this bucket. |
| `buckets[].destination` | string | required | Destination bucket; the list key. |
| `buckets[].hold` | string | enum: \["SourceEmpty", "MaxDeletesExceeded", "AwaitingTrigger"\] | Hold is set when this bucket must not run again without a person asking. Scheduled runs skip a held bucket. Only the trigger-sync annotation releases it; editing the spec does not. |
| `buckets[].lastCompletionTime` | string | format: "date-time" | LastCompletionTime is when LastJob finished. |
| `buckets[].lastError` | string | enum: \["AuthFailed", "BucketNotFound", "EndpointUnreachable", "SourceEmpty", "MaxDeletesExceeded", "VerificationFailed", "DeadlineExceeded", "TransferErrors", "Unknown"\] | LastError is a fixed reason for a failed LastJob. |
| `buckets[].lastJob` | string |  | LastJob is the last finished Job recorded for this bucket. |
| `buckets[].lastResult` | string | enum: \["Succeeded", "Failed", "Cancelled"\] | LastResult is the outcome of LastJob. |
| `buckets[].lastRunId` | string |  | LastRunID is the run of LastJob. |
| `buckets[].lastStatistics` | object |  | LastStatistics are the copy engine's counters for LastJob. Unset when the engine reported none (e.g. the Pod was killed). |
| `buckets[].lastStatistics.bytes` | integer | required; format: "int64" | Bytes is the number of bytes written to the destination. |
| `buckets[].lastStatistics.checks` | integer | required; format: "int64" | Checks is the number of objects compared and found up to date. |
| `buckets[].lastStatistics.deletes` | integer | required; format: "int64" | Deletes is the number of destination objects deleted (Mirror). |
| `buckets[].lastStatistics.differences` | integer | format: "int64" | Differences is the number of differences found by verification. |
| `buckets[].lastStatistics.elapsedSeconds` | integer | required; format: "int64" | ElapsedSeconds is the duration of the copy. |
| `buckets[].lastStatistics.errors` | integer | required; format: "int64" | Errors is the number of errors. |
| `buckets[].lastStatistics.transfers` | integer | required; format: "int64" | Transfers is the number of objects written to the destination. |
| `buckets[].lastSuccessfulTime` | string | format: "date-time" | LastSuccessfulTime is when the last successful Job for this bucket finished. |
| `buckets[].lastVerification` | string | enum: \["Passed", "Failed"\] | LastVerification is the verification outcome when verification ran. |
| `buckets[].source` | string | required | Source bucket. |
| `conditions` | array of object |  | Conditions: Ready (configuration resolved; reasons include CredentialsNotAllowed and DestinationConflict), Synced (every bucket succeeded in the last run on the current configuration), Suspended. |
| `conditions[].lastTransitionTime` | string | required; format: "date-time" | lastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another. This should be when the underlying condition changed. If that is not known, then using the time when the API field changed is acceptable. |
| `conditions[].message` | string | required; max length: 32768 | message is a human readable message indicating details about the transition. This may be an empty string. |
| `conditions[].observedGeneration` | integer | format: "int64"; min: 0 | observedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon. For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions\[x\].observedGeneration is 9, the condition is out of date with respect to the current state of the instance. |
| `conditions[].reason` | string | required; min length: 1; max length: 1024; pattern: "^\[A-Za-z\](\[A-Za-z0-9_,:\]*\[A-Za-z0-9_\])?$" | reason contains a programmatic identifier indicating the reason for the condition's last transition. Producers of specific condition types may define expected values and meanings for this field, and whether the values are considered a guaranteed API. The value should be a CamelCase string. This field may not be empty. |
| `conditions[].status` | string | required; enum: \["True", "False", "Unknown"\] | status of the condition, one of True, False, Unknown. |
| `conditions[].type` | string | required; max length: 316; pattern: "^(\[a-z0-9\](\[-a-z0-9\]*\[a-z0-9\])?(\\.\[a-z0-9\](\[-a-z0-9\]*\[a-z0-9\])?)*/)?((\[A-Za-z0-9\]\[-A-Za-z0-9_.\]*)?\[A-Za-z0-9\])$" | type of condition in CamelCase or in foo.example.com/CamelCase. |
| `currentRun` | object |  | CurrentRun describes the run in progress. |
| `currentRun.buckets` | array of string |  | Buckets lists the destination buckets taking part in the run. |
| `currentRun.completionTime` | string | format: "date-time" | CompletionTime is when the run finished. |
| `currentRun.id` | string | required | ID identifies the run; it is part of the Job names. |
| `currentRun.reason` | string | required; enum: \["Initial", "Scheduled", "Triggered"\] | Reason is why the run started. |
| `currentRun.result` | string | enum: \["Succeeded", "Failed", "Cancelled"\] | Result is Succeeded when every bucket of the run succeeded, else Failed. |
| `currentRun.specHash` | string |  | SpecHash identifies the configuration the run started with. |
| `currentRun.startTime` | string | required; format: "date-time" | StartTime is when the run started. |
| `currentRun.trigger` | string |  | Trigger is the trigger-sync annotation value that started the run. |
| `lastOperation` | object |  | LastOperation records the outcome of the last trigger-sync annotation. |
| `lastOperation.error` | string |  | Error contains the error message when Succeeded is false |
| `lastOperation.succeeded` | boolean |  | Succeeded indicates the operation completed without error |
| `lastOperation.triggeredAt` | string | format: "date-time" | TriggeredAt is when the operation was triggered |
| `lastOperation.type` | string |  | Type is the operation type (e.g. "Snapshot", "Repair:Blocks", "Scrub:start") |
| `lastRun` | object |  | LastRun describes the most recent finished run. |
| `lastRun.buckets` | array of string |  | Buckets lists the destination buckets taking part in the run. |
| `lastRun.completionTime` | string | format: "date-time" | CompletionTime is when the run finished. |
| `lastRun.id` | string | required | ID identifies the run; it is part of the Job names. |
| `lastRun.reason` | string | required; enum: \["Initial", "Scheduled", "Triggered"\] | Reason is why the run started. |
| `lastRun.result` | string | enum: \["Succeeded", "Failed", "Cancelled"\] | Result is Succeeded when every bucket of the run succeeded, else Failed. |
| `lastRun.specHash` | string |  | SpecHash identifies the configuration the run started with. |
| `lastRun.startTime` | string | required; format: "date-time" | StartTime is when the run started. |
| `lastRun.trigger` | string |  | Trigger is the trigger-sync annotation value that started the run. |
| `lastScheduleTime` | string | format: "date-time" | LastScheduleTime is the start time of the most recent run. |
| `lastSuccessfulSyncTime` | string | format: "date-time" | LastSuccessfulSyncTime is when the most recent run in which every bucket succeeded finished. |
| `lastSyncTime` | string | format: "date-time" | LastSyncTime is when the most recent run finished, whatever its result. |
| `nextSyncTime` | string | format: "date-time" | NextSyncTime is when the next scheduled run starts. Unset without a schedule or while suspended. |
| `observedGeneration` | integer | format: "int64" | ObservedGeneration is the last observed generation. |
| `phase` | string | enum: \["Pending", "Idle", "Syncing", "Suspended", "Failed"\] | Phase summarizes the state. |
